title: Register for WorkCover insurance
what: Register for WorkCover insurance with WorkSafe Victoria when employing workers in Victoria.

laws.title: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic)

sources.title: Workplace Injury Rehabilitation and Compensation Act 2013 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 434(3) (authorised version 054, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: (3) An employer to which section 430(1) applies which is not registered, and is not taken to be registered by reason of subsection (2), must apply for registration as an employer under this Act to the Authority in a form and manner approved by the Authority within 60 days after the employer becomes aware, or reasonably ought to have become aware, that section 430(1) applies to the employer.

sources.title: Do I need to register for WorkCover insurance?
sources.quote: Generally, you must register for WorkCover insurance if you or your company employs any workers in Victoria.

triggers.unit: AUD of remuneration a financial year
triggers.note: Any apprentice or trainee also triggers registration, whatever the remuneration.

sources.title: Do I need to register for WorkCover insurance?
sources.quote: You don't need to register if you or your company has no apprentices, and does not or is not liable to pay more than $7,500 in a financial year in remuneration.
